UPDATE Organizations  
            SET TotalEmployee =  
            (  
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eo.EmployeeId)
FROM EmployeeOrganizations eo
JOIN Employees e      ON e.Id  = eo.EmployeeId
JOIN Organizations o2 ON o2.Id = eo.OrganizationId  -- ← THÊM
WHERE eo.EmployeeId != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    AND eo.Concurrently = 0
    AND e.Status  >= 0
    AND eo.Status >= 0
    AND e.TrangThaiCongViec IN (1,2)
    AND eo.JobPositionId  NOT IN (SELECT Id FROM @uncountPos)
    AND eo.OrganizationId NOT IN (SELECT Id FROM @excludeOrg)
    AND eo.Organizations LIKE CONCAT('%;', @orgId, ';%')
    AND o2.Status  >= 0  -- ← THÊM
    AND o2.Stopped  = 0  -- ← THÊM
            )  
            WHERE Id = @orgId  
        END  
        ELSE  
        BEGIN  
            UPDATE Organizations  
            SET TotalEmployee =  
            (  
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeId)  
                FROM EmployeeOrganizations eo  
                JOIN Employees e ON e.Id = eo.EmployeeId  
                WHERE eo.EmployeeId != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'  
                    AND eo.Concurrently = 0  
                    AND e.Status >= 0  
                    AND eo.Status >= 0  
                    AND e.TrangThaiCongViec IN (1,2)  
                    AND eo.JobPositionId NOT IN (SELECT Id FROM @uncountPos)  
                    AND eo.OrganizationId NOT IN (SELECT Id FROM @excludeOrg)  
                    AND eo.OrganizationId = @orgId  
            )  
            WHERE Id = @orgId
